description: Web page text extraction (batch) — Fetch up to 10 web pages in one call and return each page's readable text (scripts, styles and markup stripped) with title, final URL, character and word counts, plus totals, estimated tokens and duplicate titles. urls = comma-separated URLs. Optional max = characters per page (default 4000, up to 12000). Failed pages are listed per item; you are only charged if at least one page is fetched. Price: $0.03 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: web_extract_batch
